_comment: Read by EtabsX on launch to tell the user a newer build exists. Update 'built' and 'version' when you publish a release; 'built' must match the BUILT line Release.py writes into build_info.py. Release.py prints this block ready to paste.
notes: More accurate verdicts: every seismic case is checked, nothing passes unless it was measured, the weak-storey check counts the ties, and a new check compares the ETABS base shear with BNBC V = Sa·W. The report now says up front whether it is complete and compliant.
